description: This file is a shell script used for upgrading devices via MMC storage, specifically for the ipq807x platform in an OpenWrt environment. It handles flashing kernel and root filesystem images, setting up loop devices, and formatting partitions.

methods.name: mmc_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade function that finds the kernel and root filesystem partitions and initiates flashing.

methods.name: mmc_do_flash
methods.description: Handles the flashing process by extracting images, mounting loop devices, and formatting partitions.
